investment_thesis.summary: Coinbase is the dominant onshore regulated gateway and prime custodian for institutional digital assets, uniquely hedged against market downturns by earning elevated risk-free yields on fiat stablecoin reserves in a 3.75%-4.00% fed funds regime.
return_engines: Engine 1: High-margin stablecoin reserve interest sharing (Fed policy rate at 3.75%-4.00%)
Engine 2: Institutional prime brokerage and custodial fee growth for spot ETP assets
Engine 3: Base Layer-2 network sequencer monetization and US single-stock perpetuals expansion
market_implied_assumptions: Market implies persistent transaction fee erosion and continued GAAP quarterly losses
Overlooks the 48% subscription revenue mix that generates recurring cash flow despite lower retail trading volumes
why_price_may_differ_from_value: Shares have dislocated 45% below 52-week highs due to headline rate hike anxiety, ignoring the reality that higher benchmark rates expand USDC interest cash flow.

conditions: Spot trading volumes re-accelerate; US CLARITY Act passes providing full regulatory clarity
Subscription revenue surpasses $750M per quarter; Base L2 activity hits record scale
failure_conditions: Fee take-rate compression below 0.15% across retail platforms

conditions: Retail spot volumes remain subdued but stablecoin revenue generates >$550M per quarter
Institutional custody assets remain above $200B; international derivatives expand
failure_conditions: Net outflow of institutional custodial assets

conditions: Prolonged digital asset bear market; regulatory enforcement actions in offshore derivatives
Fed slashes rates back to 1.50% wiping out stablecoin interest income
failure_conditions: Permanent impairment of core custody infrastructure

valuation.explanation: Scenario-weighted normalized earnings cross-checked against cash balance per share and stablecoin net interest margin.

catalysts.name: Launch of CFTC-Approved US Single-Stock Perpetuals
catalysts.expected_effect: Open up institutional derivative revenue streams inside the US

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 Earnings Release
catalysts.expected_effect: Validate stablecoin interest income expansion from 3.75%-4.00% fed funds

risks: Protracted retail trading apathy suppressing high-margin transaction fee generation
US Senate gridlock maintaining regulatory uncertainty for altcoin listings
Margin compression on stablecoin revenue sharing with consortium partners
invalidation_conditions: Loss of primary custody mandate for more than 40% of spot ETP assets
Sustained negative free cash flow exceeding $1.0B over four quarters

decision.summary: COIN is trading right on the cusp of its attractive threshold ($161.60-$171.97). The business is fundamentally insulated by stablecoin interest yields under current Fed rates.
required_actions: Increase allocation to full size if shares test the attractive zone below $161.60
